subject: Cost-band preflight + procurement thresholds (post-demo recap)
body:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Mia Chen <mia.chen@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Eli Navarro <eli.navarro@acmeretail.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Cost-band preflight + procurement thresholds (post-demo recap)

Hi Mia —

Thanks again for carving out time this morning. Quick recap of the two items you asked us to validate after the demo: monthly spend band (rough envelope) and procurement path / PO threshold for finance. Below is what we discussed plus the calculations we used.

High-level takeaways:
- Target monthly token volume: 80M–220M tokens (mix of short chat & batch embedding workloads).
- Expected monthly spend band (net, before committed discount): ~$3k–$9k / month depending on model choice and caching.
- Target unit econ guidance: starting target $/1M tokens = $30 (hosted; can be lower with Dedicated + quantization).
- Procurement policy: Acme’s PO threshold sits at $10k/month for direct vendor POs; under $10k, P-card is acceptable per Eli.

Attachments I’m sharing: pricing_model_rafael_v1.xlsx (breakdown by model variant, caching assumption, and sample traffic profiles). SOW draft will follow once we align on the band.

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm whether the $10k/month PO threshold is the right procurement gate.
2) If yes — we’ll size a recommended pilot (60–90 days) that keeps initial spend below PO level and prepares for a quick ramp.
3) If no — we’ll draft a procurement timeline for legal/compliance and include estimated lead times (we’ve flagged with Monica for an estimate).

Happy to jump on a quick call tomorrow to walk through the workbook.

Thanks,
Rafael
Sales Director, Redwood Inference
redwood.ai

From: Mia Chen <mia.chen@acmeretail.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Eli Navarro <eli.navarro@acmeretail.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cost-band preflight + procurement thresholds (post-demo recap)

Rafael, thanks for the summary — that helps. A couple quick clarifications before we dig into the workbook:

- Our rough internal target for pilot spend is $5k–7k / month; we'd like to keep it under the PO threshold if possible.
- Eli: can you confirm whether we can run initial pilot on P-card up to $7k, or does procurement insist on PO even for pilots?
- Also, curious how you arrived at the $30 / 1M tokens baseline — is that an average across model sizes or specific to a mid-size LLM?

If you can break out the pricing row that shows the $/1M calc by model (gpt-like vs. smaller open model), that would be helpful.

Thanks,
Mia
Director, Product Innovation
Acme Retail

---

On Mon, Aug 9, 2027 at 12:30 PM Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Mia — great notes, thanks. Replying with the quick breakout and attachments.
>
> Key assumptions used in the attached pricing_model_rafael_v1.xlsx:
> - Traffic shape: 70% short chitchat (~64 tokens/request) + 30% batch embeddings (avg 2048 tokens/request).
> - Cache hit rate: 18% for prefix caching on chat routes.
> - Model mix: 60% mid-size open model (quant-friendly), 40% larger generation variant.
>
> Pricing highlights (rounded):
> - Mid-size variant: $22 / 1M tokens (hosted baseline)
> - Large generation variant: $48 / 1M tokens
> - Weighted average under current mix: ~$30 / 1M tokens
>
> For a pilot at 90M tokens / month (midpoint of your pilot band):
> - Estimated bill (hosted, no committed discount): ~$2,700/month
> - With 15% committed discount or modest batching improvements: ~$2,300/month
>
> If you want to keep the pilot under the $10k PO threshold, we have clear levers: reduce model size, increase caching configuration, or use Dedicated spot instances for the heaviest endpoints (requires a short provisioning lead).
>
> I attached the workbook with the per-model lines you asked for.
>
> Cheers,
> Rafael

From: Kar thik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Mia Chen <mia.chen@acmeretail.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Eli Navarro <eli.navarro@acmeretail.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cost-band preflight + procurement thresholds (post-demo recap)

Hi all — adding a quick note from an econ/implementation angle.

- If you want to hit a target of ~$25 / 1M tokens, we recommend the following mix: 75% mid-size quantized models + 25% larger-gen on fallback. That profile reduces tail latency and cost.
- Batching: enabling request-level batching for embeddings could reduce the embedding per-request token overhead by ~18%, which directly reduces the effective $/1M.
- Autoscale/burst: for a small pilot, use a fixed pool with burst off — keeps cost predictable.

Practical pilot proposal (keeps procurement under $10k):
1) 60-day pilot, capped at 120M tokens total.
2) Model mix: 70/30 (mid/large), caching enabled for chat routes.
3) Monitoring: shared dashboard with token burn and projected monthly spend; auto-alert at 70% of the $10k threshold.

If that sounds right, Rafael — can you produce the pilot SOW and call out an ops lead for onboarding? Monica, can you share the expected legal turnaround if we need a PO > $10k?

Thanks,
Karthik
Applied ML / Product Economics
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Kar thik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Mia Chen <mia.chen@acmeretail.com>, Eli Navarro <eli.navarro@acmeretail.com>, Procurement <procure@acmeretail.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cost-band preflight + procurement thresholds (post-demo recap)

Hi team — quick legal/procurement note.

- If Acme needs a PO > $10k/month, legal reviews for our standard MSA + DPA typically take 8–12 business days for standard edits; more bespoke redlines add time.
- For pilots under $10k we can rely on a short SOW + standard T&Cs and use procurement’s P-card workflow.
- I’ll prepare a minimal pilot SOW draft (SOW_acmeretail_draft.pdf) that ties to the pricing model Rafael shared; it will include a simple termination clause and a 60-day evaluation window.

Next steps (summary):
- Mia/Eli: confirm pilot cap ($5k–7k vs our suggested 60–120M tokens).
- Rafael: finalize SOW and attach onboarding ops lead.
- Karthik: include monitoring thresholds in the shared dashboard.

Monica Patel
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference

---

Mia Chen (later):
> Rafael / Monica — confirmed: pilot cap at $7k on P-card to start. Please send SOW + final workbook rows by Thursday. Procurement (procure@acmeretail.com) is on copy to expedite the P-card form.

[End of thread]
